target: candidate throughput >= 2 * max(vllm throughput, sglang throughput) at every concurrency
ttfa: client elapsed time from dispatch to first complete nonempty PCM sample; includes server queueing
rtf: arithmetic mean of per-request completion seconds divided by decoded audio seconds
throughput: sum of decoded PCM duration * verified codec frame rate / cohort wall seconds
frame_rate: verify using downloaded codec config; do not assume literal 12 from model name
corpus: first 64 English and 64 Chinese Seed-TTS target transcripts, CustomVoice Ryan and Vivian; no cloning references
quality: WER/CER scored on every retained waveform; speaker similarity against independent same-preset reference audio, not Seed-TTS cloning speakers
quality_gate: pending baseline repeat distribution; freeze numeric gate before candidate optimization
completion: all requests have nonempty valid PCM and explicit successful terminal SSE event; zero request failures; clean server shutdown
